name: decision-pane
description: A pane of the decisions in decisions.md waiting on you. OK settles an item, an option button (a child line `- (a) …`) settles it with that choice, Hold folds it away, a comment keeps it open for the AI to answer and refine; held and settled items fold into their own sections. Icons and colors show whose turn it is. Setup: add the README's CLAUDE.md section, so the AI writes its open questions to decisions.md and reads it with the Read tool.
